current_date: 1 May 2026 (the document states 'this approved list of Local Validation requirements came into effect on 1st May 2026', after consultation from 16 March to 6 April 2026)
current_evidence: https://www.breckland.gov.uk/planning/local-validation-list (last modified 7 May 2026) links 'Local List 2026' (PDF, 399 KB) as the current list adopted 1 May 2026, which is the document Grokbot used. The uploaded Local_List_2026.pdf confirms it came into effect on 1 May 2026.

issues.detail: Grokbot files all 16 requirements under Full planning with the note 'application type not named', and says 'No specific local requirements identified' for every other type. In fact the list's main table has a row for each application type. Householder: Ecological Survey (where protected and priority species are likely to be present), Heritage Statement (conservation area, or curtilage/setting of a listed building or heritage asset) and Arboricultural report (where trees/hedgerows are likely to be affected). Listed Buildings: Heritage Statement, Joinery details and Schedule of works, and Structural Survey (if significant conversion, rebuilding or demolition is proposed). Outline: the same set as Full apart from Structural Survey, including Transport Assessment for majors and the self/custom build UU. Reserved Matters, Variation of Condition, Permission in Principle and Technical Details Consent rows each list several items, e.g. Ecology, Heritage, Healthy Planning Checklist, NN calculator and RAMS UU. Only the Advert and Non-Material Amendment rows are blank. The Prior Approval Part Q row marks three items 'not required to validate the application but could result in refusal if not submitted'. Grokbot has no Technical Details Consent sheet.
issues.evidence: Local List table rows: Householder, Outline, Reserved Matters, Full, Prior Approvals - Part Q, Change of Use, Variation of Condition, Advert, Non-Material Amendment, Permission in Principle, Technical Details Consent, Listed Buildings

issues.detail: Heritage Statement is missing. Trigger: site in a Conservation Area or within the curtilage/setting of a Listed Building or Heritage Asset. It applies to Householder, Outline, Reserved Matters, Full, Change of Use, Variation of Condition, Permission in Principle and Technical Details Consent, and to all Listed Building applications. Note 4 sets out the required content: history, photographic record, significance and impact assessment, and justification.
issues.evidence: Table column 'Heritage Statement 4': 'Yes, in a Conservation Area or within the curtilage/setting of a Listed Building or Heritage Asset'

issues.detail: Transport Assessment is missing. Trigger: all major development (10+ dwellings, 0.5ha+, 1,000 sqm+ or 1ha+ as defined in the notes). It applies to Outline and Full.
issues.evidence: Table column 'Transport Assessment': 'Yes for all major development'

issues.detail: Contaminated land documents are missing. Trigger: the Vulnerable Development (contamination) Questionnaire for all developments under Outline, Reserved Matters, Full, Change of Use, Variation of Condition and Technical Details Consent, plus a Site Investigation report for majors under Outline and Full, and under Change of Use only for a change to residential.
issues.evidence: Column 'Contaminated land documents 8': 'Yes - vulnerability questionnaire for all developments and Site Investigation report for majors'; note 8 'Contamination Questionnaire'

issues.detail: Healthy Planning Checklist (Planning in Health Protocol) is missing. Trigger: over 5 dwellings or 1,000 sqm of floorspace under Outline, Reserved Matters, Full, Change of Use, Variation of Condition and Technical Details Consent, and over 5 dwellings under Permission in Principle.
issues.evidence: Column 'Healthy Planning Checklist 11': 'If over 5 dwellings or 1000sqm of floorspace'

issues.detail: Nutrient Neutrality calculator and shadow HRA are missing as a requirement. Grokbot only has the fragment 'Nutrient Neutrality - Further information can be found... 13.' in tab_items. Trigger: development that generates an overnight stay in a nutrient neutrality catchment, under Outline, Reserved Matters, Full, Change of Use, Variation of Condition, Permission in Principle and Technical Details Consent.
issues.evidence: Column 'Nutrient Neutrality Calculator and sHRA 12': 'For development which generates an overnight stay in an NN catchment'

issues.detail: The Unilateral Undertaking for the Norfolk RAMS (recreational impact mitigation) is missing as a requirement. Grokbot only has a link fragment in tab_items. Trigger: where overnight stays are created, under Outline, Full, Change of Use ('additional overnight stays') and Permission in Principle. For Reserved Matters it applies if not completed at outline, and for Technical Details Consent if not secured at PiP.
issues.evidence: Column 'Unilateral Undertaking for Norfolk RAMs 13': 'Yes where overnight stays are created'; note 13

issues.detail: Air quality and dust assessment is missing. Trigger: applications that may have potential effects on air quality, under Outline, Reserved Matters, Full and Change of Use. Screening is required for any site in an AQMA, for intensive farming, or for 10+ residential units / more than 0.5ha / more than 1,000 sqm of other floorspace when coupled with more than 10 parking spaces or a centralised energy or combustion facility.
issues.evidence: Note 9 'Air Quality and Dust Impact Assessments... Air Quality screening is required for'

issues.detail: Health Impact Assessment is missing. Trigger: over 50 dwellings, under Outline, Reserved Matters, Full, Change of Use and Variation of Condition.
issues.evidence: Column 'Health Impact Assessment': 'If over 50 dwellings'

issues.detail: Community safety information is missing. Trigger: major applications only, under Outline, Reserved Matters, Full, Change of Use and Variation of Condition.
issues.evidence: Column 'Community safety' (header partly garbled in the text): 'Yes for majors only'

issues.detail: Joinery details and Schedule of works are missing. Trigger: Listed Building applications.
issues.evidence: Column 'Joinery details and Schedule of works', Listed Buildings row: 'Yes'

issues.detail: Three minerals and waste items from the Norfolk Minerals and Waste Local Plan are missing. Mineral Resource Assessment: relevant development in a Mineral Safeguarding Area (Policy MP11). Waste Management Facilities Impact Assessment: relevant development in a Waste Management Consultation Area around safeguarded waste sites (Policy WP17). Minerals Infrastructure Impact Assessment: relevant development in a Mineral Consultation Area around safeguarded mineral sites (Policies MP10/MP11). Exclusions are listed in Appendix 4 of the NM&WLP.
issues.evidence: 'Minerals and Waste - ... Breckland Council's Local List should also include requirements for'

issues.detail: Lesser items from the notes are missing. Statement of compliance with Local Plan Policy ENV09 on surface water run-off: developers must show no increase in greenfield run-off and must address Source Protection Zones and Critical Drainage Catchments. This goes with the FRA/Drainage requirement. Statement of Community Involvement: recommended for 50 or more dwellings.
issues.evidence: 'Statement of compliance with Policy ENV09...'; 'It is recommended that a statement of community involvement is submitted for dwelling numbers of 50 or more.'

issues.detail: Structural Survey's trigger excerpt is the fragment 'apply to a Structural Survey).' and gives no trigger. Under Full, the document requires it for all Policy HOU12 (conversion of rural buildings, e.g. barns) applications and where new storeys are added. It is also marked for Change of Use (the ** note allows exceptions for modern buildings), and for Listed Buildings if significant conversion, rebuilding or demolition is proposed.
issues.evidence: Full row: 'For all Policy HOU12 applications - Yes. Also where new stories are added'; definitions: 'HOU12 ... Conversion of Rural Buildings'

issues.detail: The Flood Risk Assessment and Drainage Strategy rows give no trigger. Both use the content note 'Any submitted FRA should include a Drainage Strategy...' with a stray '7.'. The real trigger is major applications or sites in areas of flood risk (Outline, Reserved Matters, Full, Change of Use, Variation of Condition), and only areas of flood risk for Technical Details Consent.
issues.evidence: Column 'Flood Risk Assessment and Drainage Strategy 6': 'Yes for major applications or in areas of flood risk.'

issues.detail: The Ecological Survey excerpt states only the 18-month age limit, not when a survey is needed. The document requires it for Outline, Reserved Matters, Full, Change of Use, Variation of Condition and Technical Details Consent, and for Householder only where protected and priority species are likely to be present. It also requires all surveys recommended in a PEA to be submitted, since a PEA alone is not enough.
issues.evidence: Householder row: 'Where any protected and priority species are likely to be present'; note 3: 'to be made valid all surveys, results and mitigations, as requested in the PEA should be provided'

issues.detail: The Noise Impact Assessment excerpt is cut off at 'air conditi' and misses the table trigger. The table requires it for major business, employment or commercial uses and for new residential development close to employment areas, under Outline, Full and Change of Use.
issues.evidence: Column 'Noise Assessment 7': 'Yes for Majors business/employment commercial uses as well as new residential developments laying close to employment areas'

issues.detail: The Ventilation/Extraction excerpt quotes only the secondary trigger (significant retail, business, industrial or leisure schemes with substantial equipment). It misses the main one: all applications for premises selling hot food, including takeaways, bars/pubs, restaurants and cafes, plus a noise assessment for hot-food uses mixed with residential.
issues.evidence: 'Ventilation and Extraction - ... should accompany all applications for premises that will be used for the sale of hot food'

issues.detail: The Design and Access Statement and Environmental Statement excerpts do not describe their requirements. The DAS excerpt is about the red line reaching the adopted highway and ownership certificates. The EIA excerpt is the national-requirements boilerplate, covering fees and local information, and it runs into the BNG heading. The document treats both as national requirements and points to GOV.UK.
issues.evidence: National Requirements: 'Design and Access Statement(1) (for some planning applications - see guidance below)'; 'Environmental Impact Assessment, where relevant'

issues.detail: The HRA excerpt is cut off at 'Conservation of Habitat'. It omits that the document says HRA information is 'not a specific Local Validation Requirement' and is recommended for all new dwellings within 13km of SPAs, SACs or Ramsar sites, especially Permission in Principle. The binding item is the NN calculator and sHRA column.
issues.evidence: Note 3: 'Although not a specific Local Validation Requirement, it is recommended that applications for all new dwellings within 13km of SPAs, SACs or Ramsar sites...'

issues.detail: Several other excerpts are garbled or cut off. BNG and Block plan start with a stray '- GOV.UK'. The BNG excerpt covers only the exemption statement and omits the statutory metric in Excel format and the competent-person statement. Lighting is cut off at 'mitig' (its trigger itself is captured). Self-build is cut off at 'primary in' and does not state the trigger ('Yes where Self/custom Build', Outline and Full) or that a Unilateral Undertaking is required.
issues.evidence: Note 2: 'Statutory Biodiversity metric (or BNG Metric) in excel format'; 'a statement should be submitted demonstrating how the person who has completed the metric meets the test of being a competent person'

issues.detail: Flood Risk Assessment and Drainage Strategy/SuDS are separate rows with the same excerpt. The document treats them as one combined requirement.
issues.evidence: Column header 'Flood Risk Assessment and Drainage Strategy 6'; note 6

issues.detail: All 7 tab_items are fragments, links or signposting, not requirements, and two are wrongly filed as 'Submission rules'. They are: the EcIA checklist link line ('...EcIA. 4.'); the tree guidance links ('...tposguide.pdf 6.'); the MAGIC mapping sentence; the HRA sentence cut off at 'Conservation of Habitat'; 'However, in some instances where there are protected or priority species then it might be...'; 'Nutrient Neutrality - Further information... 13.'; and 'Norfolk Recreational Impact Avoidance and Mitigation Strategy Action Plan - Breckland Council 14.'.
issues.evidence: Notes 3, 5, 12 and 13 of the Local List (guidance links following each numbered note)

issues.detail: 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' is not a requirement. The document only suggests requesting pre-app advice if unsure, and the excerpt is the fragment 'to request pre-application advice.'.
issues.evidence: 'Pre-application advice - Further information regarding pre-application advice can be found on our website'

issues.detail: 'Open space / play space assessment' is mislabelled. The document has no open space or play space assessment. The item is Sport England's recommended checklist for applications affecting playing field land, which is a Sport England recommendation rather than a council validation requirement.
issues.evidence: 'Sport England checklist - ... Sport England recommends that planning applications affecting playing field land should provide sport specific information'

issues.detail: The List date of 2026-05-01 is correct, but Grokbot took it from PDF metadata (CreationDate). The document itself states when the list took effect, so the date basis should cite that text.
issues.evidence: 'this approved list of Local Validation requirements came into effect on 1st May 2026'

summary: Grokbot links the correct, current Breckland Local List 2026 (in effect from 1 May 2026), but its extraction is poor. It misses about half of the list's matrix columns, including Heritage Statement, Transport Assessment, contaminated land, Healthy Planning Checklist, Health Impact Assessment, the nutrient neutrality calculator/sHRA and the RAMS UU. It also misses the three minerals and waste assessments. Grokbot ignores the table's application-type rows, putting everything under Full planning and nothing under Householder, Outline, Listed Building or other types, and many of its trigger excerpts are fragments that leave out the real thresholds.
